description: This file defines locale-specific culture information for 'en-TT' (English - Trinidad and Tobago) for the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns, timezone data, and parsing/formatting methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of the date to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current system date and time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns a new date object set to the start of the current day.
